title: Job Title: Part-Time Bookkeeper | Wave Accounting | Reconciliation & Year-End Cleanup
description:
**Job Title: Wave Accounting Bookkeeper | Reconciliation & Year-End Cleanup | Project-Based**



I’m looking for an experienced bookkeeper based in the Philippines to reconcile the existing Wave Accounting books for my US-based small businesses and prepare accurate records for my tax advisor.



The books are already in Wave, but the accounts have not been reconciled. You will need to compare the transactions against bank and credit card statements, investigate discrepancies, and make necessary corrections.



**Project Scope**



- Reconcile bank and credit card accounts against monthly statements.

- Identify missing or duplicate transactions and incorrect categories.

- Review transfers, credit card payments, owner contributions, and withdrawals for proper recording.

- Keep each business’s records separate.

- Document corrections and flag questions or missing information for my review.

- Provide reconciled profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and a summary of any unresolved items for my tax advisor.



**Requirements**



- Proven experience with Wave Accounting.

- Experience reconciling and cleaning up books for US small businesses.

- Strong attention to detail and clear written communication.

- Ability to investigate discrepancies and ask questions instead of guessing.

- Confidential handling of financial records.



**Compensation & Timeline**



This is a project-based engagement. Please provide a **fixed project fee and estimated completion timeline** after reviewing the number of businesses, accounts, months, and transactions involved.



Bank and credit card statements, existing Wave records, and available supporting documents will be provided for the work. Please identify any additional information needed to prepare an accurate quote.



There is potential for ongoing monthly bookkeeping after the initial reconciliation. Please quote that service separately.



**How to Apply**



Use the subject line **“Wave Reconciliation Bookkeeper – [Your Name]”** and include:



1. Your relevant bookkeeping and Wave Accounting experience.

2. An example of a reconciliation or cleanup project you completed.

3. What information you need from me to provide a fixed project quote.

4. Your availability and estimated turnaround time.

5. Your separate pricing for ongoing monthly reconciliation, including any account or transaction limits.



The goal is accurate, reconciled books with a clear handoff to my US tax advisor.

title: Video Editor with Team: Law Firm Social Content (Batch Editing, Fast Turnaround)
description:
About the Role



We’re a US marketing agency that manages social media for law firms. We need an experienced video editor who has a team to edit short-form videos for our attorney clients. Videos come in batches, and we need them back fast, polished, and consistent.



This role is attorney content only: educational tips, client stories, legal updates, and personal brand videos for lawyers. The style should look modern and engaging while still professional and trustworthy.

Use a modern editing style: punchy cuts, motion text, zooms, transitions, sound design

Meet turnaround deadlines on every batch

Most videos are in English. Some include short lines spoken in Turkish, Arabic, French or Spanish. You don’t need to speak these languages, but you must caption them accurately. That means using the correct accents and special characters, writing Arabic right-to-left, and checking AI transcriptions before delivering. Getting these right matters to us.

Strong attention to detail. Legal content can’t have errors or change what the attorney said.



Nice to Have



Experience editing for lawyers, law firms or other professional service brands

Experience captioning non-English speech

Ability to create reusable templates for each client’s brand



How to Apply



Start your application with the word “PAPAYA” so we know you read the full post. Applications without it won’t be reviewed.



Please include:



Your portfolio, with 3–5 short-form examples (professional or legal content preferred)

How many people are on your team and what each person does

Your usual turnaround time for a batch of 10 videos

Whether you’ve captioned videos in Turkish, Arabic, French or Spanish before

title: Customer Support Assistant
description:
Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We are a Swedish e-commerce company running several brands. Every brand gets customer
s every day, and every one of them needs a correct answer the same day. Forever.



Your job: clear the support inboxes every day. Different brands, different languages, the same questions over and over:



"Where is my delivery?"

Order not received.

Product not as expected.

Returns and exchanges.

General questions about the brand.



The
s are boring. The job is not. Here is what a normal day actually looks like:



Open the inboxes. Look each order up in Shopify. Find the tracking. Reply in the customer's language using DeepL, following our reply guide.

When tracking has been dead for a week, you do not tell the customer "please wait." You message our shipping agents in China, get an answer, and then tell the customer what is actually happening and when.

When a customer opens a dispute with their bank, you collect the evidence — order, tracking, delivery proof, your
 thread — and submit it to the payment provider. Before the deadline. Without being reminded.

When the same problem shows up three times in one week, you write it down and tell us. Once, with numbers.



The tools: Shopify admin,
, DeepL, the carriers' tracking pages, the payment provider's dispute portal, and a chat with our China agents. We teach you our setup in week one. Shopify admin you must already know: previous hands-on experience in Shopify admin is required.





THE ONE THING THIS JOB IS REALLY ABOUT

We are in Sweden and we spend our days running ads. We are not going to sit next to you. If you message us "what should I do?" three times a day, this job has failed — for both of us.



The rule is simple. Before anything reaches us, you have already tried to solve it. When it still has to reach us, it arrives like this — four lines, nothing else:



The problem: Order 4471, tracking dead for 11 days, customer threatening a chargeback.

What I already did: Checked the carrier page, asked the China agent on Monday and again on Wednesday, no reply.

What I propose: Offer a replacement now, refund only if there is no scan by Friday.

What I need from you: A yes or a no.



That is the whole job in four lines. Anyone can answer "where is my order" when the tracking works. I am hiring the person who knows what to do when it doesn't — and who d
 first and asks second.



Quick question, and I mean it: a customer writes in Danish, and DeepL is down for the whole day. What do you do? Make your answer the very last thing you say in your application video. You'll see why below.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

1. You show up. Every single day, Saturday and Sunday included. Not "most days." Not "I had internet problems." Every day.

2. The inbox is cleared inside your window, every day. Nothing sits for more than 24 hours without a reply.

3. You d
 first and ask second. Every time something reaches us, it comes with your proposed solution.

4. You stay. We are building a team, not renting an assistant for two months.

5. Your English and your tone are good enough — and get better.



Notice that skill is fifth on this list. That is not a mistake. The one skill you must bring is Shopify admin. Everything else we can teach you: our brands, our reply guide, our shipping, our tone — we have a whole system for it, and the person who reads this carefully and types "kanelbulle" as the first word of the subject line when applying is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the subject line structure below, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the structure. What we cannot teach is a person who opens the inbox every single day for the next two years, weekends included, and who would rather make a decision than wait for one.





HOURS — READ THIS PART HONESTLY

This is work on demand. There is no fixed shift. The rule is simple: the inbox is cleared every day, 7 days a week, inside 10:00–17:00 Swedish time. If you are in the Philippines, that window is 17:00–00:00 right now (16:00–23:00 in summer). You d
 when inside it. The workload has grown fast: right now the job takes several hours every day, and it keeps growing as we add brands and tasks. Weekends are never optional.



You log the hours you actually work, and you are paid for them. More hours come with more brands and more tasks.



If you cannot open the inbox every single day, including weekends, do not apply. That is the entire job.





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

Hourly rate, paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



The rate ladder, in writing:



Start: $2.50 USD per hour.

After 1 month: $3.00 USD per hour.

After 3 months: $3.50 USD per hour.

After 6 months: $4.00 USD per hour.



Every step is automatic if you are still clearing the inbox every day. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget." The first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month.



On top of that:



$20 USD consistency bonus every month you open the inbox on every single day with zero missed days. This is the easiest money in the job, and it is entirely within your control.

$3 USD per Trustpilot review. Every 4- or 5-star review from a real customer that mentions you by name. Uncapped, and this is the real upside. A customer who was angry on Monday and names you in a 5-star review on Thursday is exactly the job, and you get paid for it every time it happens. Each review is matched to a real order before it is paid.



One line on that, because it matters: you never ask a customer for a rating, you never offer a customer anything for a review, and you never write one yourself. One fake, bought or nudged review and the seat is gone the same day. The reviews you get paid for are the ones you earned by fixing the problem so well that the customer wanted to say your name.



You are paid for the hours you actually work, not for counting
s. Some days are calmer. Some days are a full inbox and a dispute deadline. Either way, the day is cleared.





WHAT COUNTS AS DONE

Every customer
 that arrived before 17:00 Swedish time is answered the same day, in the customer's language, following the reply guide, with the order looked up in Shopify. Every dispute is answered before its deadline. Anything that reaches us comes in the four-line format above. Not a taste judgment. If I send something back, I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please save us both the time. Do not apply if:



You cannot open the inbox every single day, Saturday and Sunday included.

Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

You need someone to tell you what to do for each
.

You take angry customers personally, or argue with them.

You have never worked in Shopify admin for a real store. Not "seen it" — worked in it.

You are not comfortable recording a short video of yourself with your camera on.

You want to negotiate the rate upward before you've proven a single month.

You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better.

You want the "future tasks" at the bottom of this post to be the job now. They come after months of a cleared inbox, not before.



I'm not being harsh for fun. I'd rather describe the job exactly than lose a good person who wanted a different one.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.



1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:

| [most customer
s you have ever answered in ONE day] | [years using Shopify admin] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | 45 | 2 | 2 | 7 | 40mbps



Wrong format or a missing field — deleted unread. If the Shopify field says 0, deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances.



2. Your message contains ONE thing: a link to a Loom video. Nothing else. No written answers, no cover letter, no CV.



It must be Loom (
). Not YouTube, not Google Drive, not a file. The free Loom plan is enough. Set the link so anyone with it can watch. Maximum 5 minutes. In English. Camera on, your face visible the whole time.



In the video, cover these six things, in this order:



1. Who you are, and the most customer
s you have ever answered in one day. For which store, and what kind of tickets.

2. Your Shopify experience. Which stores, for how long, and what you actually did in Shopify admin. Then: the first thing you open in Shopify admin when a customer says the package hasn't arrived, and what you look at there.

3. Your setup. Computer, internet provider, backup internet, and what you do when the power goes out. Open speedtest.net on your screen and run it while you record. The number must match your subject line.

4. Longevity. The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client, how long, and why it ended. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one.

5. What would make you quit this job. Everyone has a breaking point. Tell me yours. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."

6. The last thing you say in the video: the answer to the question I asked you earlier in this post. If it isn't there, you didn't read the post. If it is, I already know two things about you.



Never show a client's Shopify admin, customer names or orders on your screen. Protecting customer data is part of this job, so it is part of the test.



3. If I message you, reply within 24 hours. If you don't, I move on to the next applicant. Answering fast is part of the job, so it is part of the test.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The application above. A Loom of up to 5 minutes. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The inbox test. Unpaid. If your video is sharp, I send you five real customer
s (names removed) in three languages, our reply guide, and access to DeepL. You return five written replies within 24 hours. One of the five has no answer in the guide. I am watching what you do with that one: guess, ask a smart question, or find it. Anything that has to reach me comes in the four-line format. I am not grading style. I am grading: did you follow the guide exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you d
 before you asked. This is a real preview of the daily job.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week on one brand's live inbox. Real customers, real China agents, real feedback. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One company, several brands, the same people every day. You choose when you work inside the window. Pay on time, twice a month, without ever having to ask. A rate that grows on a schedule you can see, and hours that grow with the work. Someone who tells you exactly what's wrong in one sentence so you can fix it and get better fast.



And a real path. Once the inbox has been cleared every day for months, the next tasks are real: finding products, searching for ad videos, writing ad copy, product descriptions, talking to UGC creators and influencers. We train you for them. But that comes after, not instead.



And the upside has no ceiling: every customer who names you in a 4- or 5-star review is $3 in your pocket, forever, on top of everything above.



If you're the kind of person who is tired of clients who never answer, and who just wants a seat, a standard to hit, and to be paid reliably for hitting it — this is that.



Show me you can follow instructions, and show me you can d
. That's the whole first test.

title: Affiliate Program Setup Specialist
description:
About the Project



We are looking for an experienced Affiliate Marketing Specialist to build and launch a professional affiliate program for our online education course focused on investing in humanoid robotics (
)



We need someone who has successfully set up affiliate programs for digital courses or information products and understands how to make them attractive to affiliates, profitable for the business, and protected against fraud.



Your Two Main Responsibilities



1. Build & Set Up a Complete Affiliate Program



Design and implement all aspects of a successful, competitive, and scalable affiliate program, including:



Research and recommend an attractive, competitive, and profitable commission structure.



Design commission tiers, performance bonuses, cookie durations, and affiliate incentives.



Recommend and configure the best affiliate tracking software and integrations.



Set up affiliate registration, approval, tracking, dashboards, and payouts.



Implement fraud prevention measures to protect against fake transactions, self-referrals, cookie stuffing, chargebacks, suspicious traffic, and other affiliate abuse.



Create affiliate terms and conditions, promotional rules, and commission policies.



Establish affiliate screening, payment verification, and commission approval procedures.



Ensure proper tracking, reporting, refund handling, and affiliate attribution.



Develop necessary affiliate onboarding materials and program information.



Implement appropriate advertising disclosure and financial marketing compliance safeguards.



Fully test the affiliate program to ensure everything works correctly before launch.



Goal: Deliver a fully operational, professionally structured affiliate program that attracts legitimate affiliates, protects our business, and maximizes profitability.



2. Register & Launch Our Program on Major Affiliate Platforms



Identify, evaluate, and register our affiliate program on the largest and most relevant affiliate networks, marketplaces, and directories for digital products, online courses, financial education, and information products.



Platforms to evaluate include:



ClickBank



Digistore24



Awin



CJ Affiliate







Other major affiliate marketplaces and relevant affiliate program directories



Your responsibilities include:



Research all major relevant platforms and recommend which ones we should join.



Handle the entire application, registration, and setup process.



Create compelling, optimized affiliate program listings that attract affiliates.



Complete platform integrations and configure commission structures and tracking.



Work through platform approval requirements and resolve application issues.



Ensure listings are accurate, professional, and optimized for affiliate discovery.



Provide a spreadsheet showing every platform evaluated, submitted, approved, and launched, including live listing URLs.



Goal: Get our affiliate program successfully approved, integrated, and listed on as many major, reputable, relevant affiliate platforms as practical, so potential affiliates can easily discover and join it.



Required Experience



Proven experience setting up affiliate programs for online courses, digital products, or information products.



Hands-on experience with ClickBank, Digistore24, or similar major affiliate marketplaces.



Strong knowledge of affiliate commission structures, tracking, payouts, and fraud prevention.



Experience registering merchants and getting affiliate programs approved on major networks.



Understanding of affiliate marketing compliance, especially for investing or financial education.



Ability to independently execute the entire project from start to finish.



Excellent organizational, research, and communication skills.



We are looking for someone with real, demonstrated experience—not someone who will be learning affiliate program setup on the job.



Project Deliverables



A fully configured, tested, and operational affiliate program.



A competitive and financially sustainable commission and incentive structure.



Comprehensive anti-fraud protections and affiliate operating policies.



Completed registrations, approvals, and live listings on applicable major affiliate marketplaces.



Documentation of all platforms, integrations, accounts, and procedures.



Potential Long-Term Opportunity



This is initially a project-based role focused exclusively on setting up and launching our affiliate program. Once this project is successfully completed, we can discuss a long-term opportunity to actively recruit affiliates, build partnerships, manage affiliate relationships, and grow affiliate-driven sales.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



Which affiliate programs have you personally built and launched? Please provide examples.



Which major affiliate platforms (ClickBank, Digistore24, Awin, etc.) have you successfully registered merchants on?



Which platforms would you recommend for our humanoid robotics investing education course, and why?



What commission structure and anti-fraud measures would you recommend?



How long would you expect the setup process to take, excluding third-party approval delays?



What is your proposed fixed project fee, and what deliverables would it include?



Please provide examples of your previous work. We will prioritize applicants who have successfully launched affiliate programs for digital courses or information products.

title: Remote Construction & FF&E Procurement Coordinator (US PST Night Shift)
description:
Remote FF&E & Design Procurement Coordinator (US PST Night Shift)



Type: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Schedule: Night shift, Pacific Time — 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST (1:00 AM – 10:00 AM PHT, or 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT during daylight saving)

Pay: $6/hour, inclusive of night differential, commensurate with experience

About the Studio

We are a boutique interior design studio in Los Angeles focused exclusively on commercial projects. Because we are small and fast-moving, you will work directly with the Principal Designer every day, keeping materials, finishes, and furnishings moving smoothly from concept to installation.



The Role

We are looking for an organized, design-minded FF&E & Procurement Coordinator to own the full procurement cycle for our projects — sourcing, specification, quoting, purchasing, and delivery tracking of finishes and Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E). You will be the central link between our design studio, trade showrooms, manufacturer reps, and installers.

What You Will Do

•	Source materials and furnishings: Contact lighting, tile, plumbing, hardware, and furniture showrooms and reps for trade pricing, stock, lead times, freight quotes, and physical samples.

•	Manage specifications: Build, organize, and audit finish, lighting fixture, and hardware schedules in Excel/Google Sheets, keeping every spec aligned with the approved design.

•	Support design documentation: Compile manufacturer cut sheets, installation guides, and CAD blocks into clean, organized packages for contractor coordination.

•	Handle purchasing: Draft purchase orders, check vendor invoices line by line against approved quotes and design documents, and confirm finishes, dimensions, and quantities before payment.

•	Track orders and deliveries: Follow production timelines, backorders, shipments, and freight to job sites or receiving warehouses, and flag delays early.

•	Coordinate meetings: Schedule design presentations, vendor calls, and project meetings, prepare agendas, take clear notes, and circulate action items to the team and vendors.

•	Follow up
 Call and
 US showrooms, vendors, and installers during LA business hours on our company VoIP line to resolve discrepancies and secure updates.

What You Bring

•	2+ years in design procurement, FF&E purchasing, showroom coordination, or architectural support — ideally gained inside an architecture, interior design, or construction firm, and ideally with US-based clients.

•	A proven, sustainable routine for working a full US night shift (PST or EST).

•	The ability to read floor plans, elevations, and spec sheets — dimensions, finish codes, and material details.

•	Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and the ability to learn new design and project tools quickly (we will train you on our studio’s software).

•	Fluent, professional written and spoken English for daily contact with US reps and vendors.

•	A reliable home office: fiber internet (50 Mbps minimum), a verified backup connection, backup power, and a quiet space for calls.

Bonus Points

•	CAD ability — our top preference. Comfortable working with CAD drawings and blocks to compile manufacturer cut sheets and installation guides into coordinated packages.

•	A degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

•	Familiarity with design materials — tile, architectural lighting, plumbing and door hardware, and commercial furnishings.

•	Experience working with trade showrooms and design reps (e.g., building product libraries and sample programs).

•	Hands-on experience with Programa, Procore, Bluebeam, or Studio Designer.

•	Prior experience working on a US-based architecture, interior design, or construction team.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short cover message answering these three questions. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.

1.	Which design, project, or documentation tools have you used (e.g., Excel, CAD, or design software), and how?

2.	Describe a time you caught an error in a quote, spec sheet, or purchase order before production or delivery.

3.	Confirm you can work 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST full-time, and briefly describe your primary and backup internet and power setup.

title: Full Time Video Editor for One YouTube Channel (Long Term, Work From Home)
description:
We are Rebuild Rescue, a growing YouTube channel in the United States. We rescue airplanes, boats, cars, and trucks and film the full story: finding the deal, inspecting it, getting it running, cleaning it up, and selling it. Our episodes run 25 to 45 minutes and publish every other week, and we are building the team to publish weekly.



We are hiring ONE full time video editor in the Philippines to be part of our own team. This is not agency work and not a freelance rotation. You would work for our channel only, and we are looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with the channel for years.



How the work runs:

You edit on our computers, not yours. You log in remotely over Parsec to a fast editing workstation at our offices, where the footage already lives on our server, synced and organized. No huge downloads and no shipping drives. Projects arrive ready to cut. Your job is the full edit of each episode, start to finish: assembly, story, pacing, sound, and a finished episode ready to go. Our head editor reviews the final cut before it publishes.



What we are looking for:

Proven long form YouTube editing. You understand pacing and storytelling that keeps viewers watching, and you can cut voiceover driven stories in the style of channels like Mat Armstrong. Send us full episodes you edited, not just shorts or ads. Premiere Pro preferred. Above all, you are reliable and you hit deadlines. That matters more to us than anything on a resume.



Pay and terms:

Pay is based on experience and ability, and your trial edit helps set your rate. Pay is reviewed after your first episodes ship and steps up as your work proves out. Paid reliably and on time, every time. 13th month pay included. This is a long term position, not a project.



The process:

Finalists will complete a paid trial edit on real footage from our channel before any hire. We pay for the trial whether or not you get the job, and the quality of that trial is what sets your starting rate.



To apply:

Send links to two or three long form videos you personally edited and tell us exactly what your role was on each. Tell us where you are in the Philippines, your current work situation (employed, freelance, between roles), and your honest turnaround time for a 30 minute video from organized footage.

title: Senior Brand Manager needed to support 10+ Amazon brands for growth, execution, drive performance and operation
description:
About Prodigy Media



Prodigy Media is an established e-commerce company with over a decade of experience developing, launching, and scaling private-label brands, primarily on Amazon USA.

We're looking for someone with extensive Amazon marketplace experience who understands how to grow brands, improve profitability, launch products successfully, and coordinate teams to get results.



This is a senior-level position for someone who can think strategically, solve problems independently, and take ownership of performance.



We're also embracing modern AI tools to help our team work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Experience with Claude, Codex, or automation tools is highly valued, but strong Amazon brand management experience is our number one priority.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Brand Management & Growth

You'll be responsible for overseeing and improving the performance of assigned Amazon private-label brands.

Manage multiple Amazon brands and product portfolios.

Analyze sales, profitability, organic rankings, conversion rates, traffic, and advertising performance.

Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve margins, and grow market share.

Develop and execute strategies to improve underperforming products.

Oversee listing optimization, SEO, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and conversion improvements.

Conduct competitive analysis and identify market opportunities.

Monitor inventory-related issues that affect sales and performance.

Develop clear short-term and long-term growth strategies for assigned brands.

Our expectation: You don't just maintain Amazon listings. You actively manage and grow the business.



2. Data Analysis, Problem Solving & Execution



Strong analytical skills are essential, but identifying problems is only the beginning.

We're looking for someone who can:

Analyze data to identify declining sales, poor conversion rates, advertising inefficiencies, and other performance issues.

Investigate the underlying causes rather than simply reporting numbers.

Develop practical solutions supported by research and data.

Implement corrective actions and coordinate the necessary resources.

Monitor results and continuously improve strategies.

Take responsibility for resolving issues from beginning to end.

We don't need someone who simply tells us what's wrong. We need someone who knows how to fix it and takes action.



3. Amazon Product Launches



You must have direct, hands-on experience launching private-label products on Amazon.

Responsibilities include:

Conducting product and competitor research.

Performing keyword research and analyzing market opportunities.

Developing product launch strategies, budgets, and timelines.

Coordinating product photography, listing content, A+ Content, and launch assets.

Working with PPC specialists on launch campaigns and advertising strategies.

Planning compliant product review acquisition strategies.

Coordinating inventory readiness and launch schedules.

Monitoring launch performance and optimizing strategies to improve rankings, conversions, and sales.

You should understand the complete Amazon launch process, from preparation to successful market entry and continued growth.



4. Team Coordination & Project Management



You'll work directly with our PPC specialists, graphic designers, and operations team to ensure brand initiatives are completed effectively.

Coordinate PPC strategies and campaign priorities with advertising specialists.

Work closely with graphic designers to develop listing images, A+ Content, advertising creatives, and product videos.

Assign projects, set clear priorities, and establish realistic due dates.

Manage multiple ongoing projects and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

Review creative assets and campaign initiatives to ensure they support brand objectives.

Identify bottlenecks and resolve delays before they affect performance.

Maintain accountability and clear communication across teams.

Use project management systems to organize assignments, responsibilities, and deadlines.

You must be comfortable leading execution, making decisions, and ensuring that important work gets completed without constant supervision.



5. External Marketing & Brand Development



While Amazon is our main sales channel, we also want to expand our brand presence and customer acquisition efforts beyond Amazon.

Experience or familiarity with the following is valuable:

 and Instagram advertising.

TikTok marketing and short-form video content.

Influencer marketing and UGC creators.

External traffic strategies that drive customers to Amazon.

Affiliate marketing and customer acquisition campaigns.

Shopify and direct-to-consumer marketing.

We're looking for someone who understands how to use outside marketing channels to build brand awareness and support Amazon sales growth.



6. AI Tools, Automation & Operational Improvements



We're continuously improving our business through AI and modern technology.

While this is not a software development position, we value Amazon professionals who are comfortable using AI to improve their productivity and solve business problems.

Experience with the following is a strong advantage:

Claude and Claude Code.

OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT.

AI-assisted Amazon research, analytics, and reporting.

Automating repetitive business tasks and workflows.

Building or customizing simple internal tools using AI.

We especially value people who are willing to invest time in exploring AI-powered applications or automations that eliminate operational bottlenecks and help the company operate more efficiently.



Minimum Qualifications



Required:

At least 4 years of proven Amazon brand management experience, preferably managing US private-label brands.

Demonstrated experience growing Amazon sales and improving brand performance.

Direct experience successfully launching new products on Amazon.

Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and advertising fundamentals.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical solutions.

Experience coordinating with PPC specialists, graphic designers, and other team members.

Excellent project management skills, including assigning priorities and meeting deadlines.

Good understanding of Amazon profitability, margins, conversion rates, and organic rankings.

Familiarity with external marketing strategies.

Strong English communication and independent problem-solving skills.



Highly Preferred:



Experience managing multiple Amazon brands simultaneously.

Advanced knowledge of Data Dive, Helium 10, and Amazon Brand Analytics.

Experience with Meta, TikTok, influencer marketing, or UGC campaigns.

Practical experience using Claude, Codex, and other AI tools.

Experience creating automations, dashboards, or simple internal business applications.

Familiarity with ClickUp, Notion, and workflow management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a proactive, results-driven Amazon professional who:

Understands what drives profitable Amazon brand growth.

Can manage multiple brands and identify the right priorities.

Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they're resolved.

Works effectively with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Can independently coordinate projects, deadlines, and resources.

Is constantly looking for opportunities to improve business performance.

Is open to adopting AI tools and developing more efficient systems.



As an experienced Amazon Brand Manager first, with a strong interest in using technology to become even more effective.



What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, we expect you to:

Develop a clear understanding of your assigned brands and their performance.

Identify the biggest opportunities to improve sales, profitability, and conversion rates.

Create actionable growth plans with measurable objectives.

Resolve high-priority issues affecting brand performance.

Establish effective coordination with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Improve project accountability and timely delivery of creative and marketing initiatives.

Demonstrate strong ownership, independent decision-making, and measurable progress.

Identify opportunities where AI tools or automation could make existing workflows more efficient.



Most importantly, you take ownership of the results.



If this sounds like you and you would like to apply. Please send your resume directly to myself with the subject line : SBM with Passion for AI





Tam Ma

Co Founder - Prodigy Media

title: LinkedIn Networking & Candidate Community Ambassador
description:
Create a LinkedIn profile and connect with people in the lending and banking industry!





We are building a professional career networking platform connecting mortgage and lending professionals with career opportunities and industry relationships.



We are hiring independent freelancers to represent us on LinkedIn, build authentic professional connections, and help attract qualified candidates to our platform.



This is an ongoing networking and community-building role. Your initial focus will be developing relationships with professionals in specific job categories. Over time, you will also share content, participate in conversations, and introduce interested professionals to the platform.



**PLEASE READ REQUIREMENTS FOR THIS ROLE AT THE END



What you’ll do:



Identify mortgage and lending professionals using specific job titles, companies, and other criteria we provide.



Build relevant connections through thoughtful, personalized outreach.



Develop professional relationships through appropriate follow-up and genuine conversation.



Engage with relevant industry posts through meaningful comments and discussions.



Share approved content and write original posts using our messaging guidelines.



Explain the platform’s benefits and encourage interested professionals to visit the site and create a candidate profile.



Answer basic questions and refer more detailed inquiries to our team.



Provide a weekly summary of activity, relevant connections, conversations, candidate interest, and attributable registrations.



Who you’ll connect with:



We will assign specific candidate segments. Examples include:



Mortgage loan processors



Mortgage underwriters



Loan closers and funders



Post-closing specialists



Loan officers and loan originators



Branch managers



Mortgage operations managers



Quality control and compliance professionals



Who we’re looking for:



Strong written English and a friendly, professional communication style.



An interest in networking and building relationships.



Good judgment about when and how to introduce a platform or opportunity.



Strong organization and consistent follow-through.



Comfort representing the platform transparently as a paid independent contractor, and eventually contract employee of the company.



Experience in mortgage lending, recruiting, community management, or social media outreach is helpful but certainly not required.



****REQUIREMENTS:*****



LinkedIn profile requirements:



You must personally operate your own authentic LinkedIn profile using your real identity and accurate professional information. Your profile should accurately describe your work with us and the platform.  You will be required to use your real name and identity on LinkedIn and not create fake or spam accounts that will be blocked.  We also require that you have a paid subscription to LinkedIn which will be reimbursed or paid for by us after verifying your real identity.  To verify your real identity with LinkedIn they will require proof of a government issued ID (e-passport for Phillippines).  Once you have a profile established with your real identity verified, we are able to hire you for this ongoing project.  You will also need to use your personal mobile phone (no VOIP or free text numbers) for identity verification with them.



People who do not currently have a LinkedIn account are welcome to apply and may create their first authentic profile if selected. Applicants with an existing authentic profile are also welcome, but should have minimal to no connections outside of the scope of this project. 



Your personal profile remains yours. We will not request your password or ownership of your account. Duplicate or fabricated profiles, account rentals, automated connection or messaging tools, and bulk unsolicited messaging are not part of this role. All activity must follow LinkedIn’s rules.



What we provide



An introduction to our platform and its audience.



Target job titles and candidate selection guidelines.



Brand information, content ideas, and outreach guidance.



Training on platform benefits and common candidate questions.



Regular feedback and coordination with our team.



Engagement



This is a remote, part-time freelance opportunity with potential for ongoing work. This role does not require set hours during the workday - can be any time.   



We value relevant relationships, meaningful engagement, and qualified candidate registrations. Success will be evaluated on the quality and results of your work, not simply the number of connection requests sent.

title: Video Editor
description:
Subject: Job post: Video Editor



JOB TITLE



Video Editor (Work From Home)





PAY



$6.25 per hour





ABOUT US



Deep Due Diligence is the home of the DDD Report, a complete evidence report for performance, luxury and collector vehicles. Car dealers in the United States order a DDD Report so their buyers can see the proof before they buy: the mechanic's inspection, an unedited video of the car, the title checks and the service records, all in one report.



We're a growing US company with a premium, luxury brand, and we need a skilled editor to make our videos look as polished as the cars we cover.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Edit YouTube videos (3 to 10 minutes) explaining what a DDD Report is and how it helps car buyers and dealers.



2. Cut short vertical videos (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok) from our longer videos.



3. Edit short, fun story-style ads with a clear, professional finish.



4. Add clean captions, titles and on-screen text.



5. Add licensed background music and sound effects, and balance the voice and music levels.



6. Work with our social media team member, who plans the videos and provides scripts, voiceovers and raw footage.





THE STYLE WE WANT



Our brand is luxury and premium, like the websites of Ferrari, Porsche or Apple. That means:



- Smooth, steady pacing. No choppy or jumpy cuts.



- One consistent narrator voice per video.



- Clean, simple text and graphics. No cheap or cartoon effects.



- Professional color and sound.





REQUIREMENTS



1. At least 2 years of video editing experience.



2. A portfolio showing your work. Car, luxury, real estate or brand videos are a big plus.



3. Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro. CapCut alone is not enough.



4. Experience editing both long YouTube videos and short vertical videos.



5. Experience with captions, sound mixing and basic color correction.



6. Able to meet deadlines and take feedback well.



7. Good written English for messages with our team.



8. A reliable computer and fast internet for uploading large video files.



Nice to have: motion graphics (After Effects), AI voice or AI video tools, and experience with US clients.





SCHEDULE



Part-time with flexible hours. You'll work to deadlines on each video. Please be available for short check-ins during US business hours (Pacific Time) a few times a week.





PAID TEST PROJECT



Our top applicants will be asked to complete a short, paid test edit before we hire. This lets us see your style, and lets you see how we work.





HOW TO APPLY



 your application to: 



Please include all of the following. Applications missing any item won't be reviewed.



1. Use "DDD Report Video Editor" as your
 subject, so we know you read the full post.



2. Links to your portfolio, with at least 3 videos you edited. Include at least one short vertical video.



3. A short note telling us which editing programs you use and how many years you've been editing.



4. How many hours per week you're available.



5. Your available start date.



We look forward to seeing your work!



The Deep Due Diligence Hiring Team

title: YouTube Video Editor for Vlog Content (Long-Form Vlogs + Shorts)
description:
ABOUT US

We are a US-based entrepreneur growing a YouTube channel built on vlog-style content: day-in-the-life, behind-the-scenes of running a business, and everyday moments on the road. We film a lot. We need an editor who can turn hours of raw footage into vlogs people actually watch to the end.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 2-3 long-form vlogs per week (10-25 minutes each) from raw footage, often 1-3 hours per video

- Find the story: pick the hook for the first 30 seconds, cut dead air, and build a clear beginning, middle and end

- Keep the pacing tight with jump cuts, B-roll, zooms, sound effects and music that fits the mood

- Basic color correction and audio cleanup (levels, noise reduction, voice clarity)

- Add captions, text callouts and simple motion graphics where they help

- Cut 3-5 YouTube Shorts / vertical clips from each long-form vlog

- Suggest thumbnail frames and title ideas for each video

- Keep footage and project files organized in a shared Google Drive



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year editing YouTube vlogs or long-form storytelling content (portfolio required)

- Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- A strong sense of storytelling and retention: you know why viewers click away at minute 2 and how to stop it

- Comfortable with large files and fast turnaround (48-72 hours per vlog)

- Good written English and a reliable internet connection that can handle large uploads and downloads

- Available for a few hours each day that overlap with US Eastern time



NICE TO HAVE

- Thumbnail design (Photoshop or Canva)

- After Effects or other motion graphics tools

- Experience reading YouTube Studio analytics (audience retention, CTR)

- Experience editing for lifestyle, travel or business creators



PAY

$500-$700/month full-time, based on skill and speed. Raises after 90 days based on quality and channel growth.



HOW TO APPLY

2. Send links to 2-3 YouTube vlogs you edited, and tell us what you did on each one

3. Tell us your editing software and your usual turnaround for a 15-minute vlog

MUST HAVE

title: Instagram DM Appointment Setter for a Marriage Coaching Business
description:
The Relationship Code is a marriage coaching business run by Marc and Michelle Landau in San Diego, California. We help couples whose marriage is in crisis, including husbands whose wives are asking for a divorce or separation, learn how to communicate again, rebuild trust, and save their marriage. We get daily DMs from people who found us through our Instagram content and our live events, and we need a caring, sharp appointment setter to reply, follow up, and book them onto free discovery calls with our team.

This is sensitive work. Many people who message us are hurting and scared. We are looking for someone who can be warm and human first, and a great setter second.

What you'll do

Reply to inbound Instagram DMs in Meta Business Suite. Our automations (ManyChat) deliver free resources when people comment a keyword. From the person's first real reply, a human takes over. That human is you.

Have short, caring conversations that follow our script: listen first, reflect back what they said, ask one question at a time, and guide qualified people to book a free discovery call.

Follow up with people who booked a discovery call but did not show up, and work to rebook them.

Follow up with open conversations on a set schedule: 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days, then 30 days, 60 days, and 90 days.

Never quote prices, make promises about outcomes, or give marriage advice or coaching in the DMs. Your one job in the chat is a booked call.

If a conversation involves anything serious, such as abuse or someone talking about harming themselves, stop and escalate it to Marc right away.

Track every lead in our CRM (GoHighLevel), and log your daily numbers on our scorecard: conversations started, follow ups sent, calls booked, calls rebooked.

Daily targets

Every open conversation replied to within 1 hour during your shift

30 to 50 follow up messages per day

1 to 2 discovery calls booked or rebooked per day

Hours

3:00 AM to 11:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday, 8 hours per day. This covers 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Pacific time, when our audience is messaging us. These are night shift hours, so please only apply if that schedule works for you long term.

Pay

$800 per month, paid twice a month via Wise. 30 day trial, then a performance review and a raise path based on calls booked and show rates.

You're a fit if you

Write natural, warm, friendly English with no grammar mistakes. Our audience cannot tell you are not in the US, and your messages never sound like a bot or a script.

Have at least 1 year of DM sales, appointment setting, chat support, or customer service experience. Experience with Instagram, Meta Business Suite, ManyChat, or GoHighLevel is a big plus.

Can follow a script exactly while still sounding like a real person.

Are comfortable working for a faith based business and speaking with couples in crisis with patience and respect.

Have stable internet, a backup connection if possible, and a quiet place to work.

How to apply

Start your application with the word BLUE.

Answer this. A lead messages us and asks, how much is your coaching? Write the exact reply you would send.

Answer this. A lead booked a discovery call yesterday and did not show up. Write the exact follow up message you would send them today.

Tell us in 2 to 3 sentences about your best result booking calls or closing sales.

Applications that skip any of these steps won't be reviewed.

Start your message with the word BODYCAM so we know you read this post. Then send:

title: Property Operations & Finance VA
description:
We are looking for an experienced Property Communications, Bookings & Finance Virtual Assistant to join our UK property business.



We manage serviced accommodation and HMO properties. We need someone who can take ownership of our daily communications, convert enquiries into confirmed bookings and keep our financial administration accurate and up to date.



You should communicate clearly, work confidently with numbers, prioritise effectively and follow tasks through without repeated reminders.



This is a full-time remote role, Monday to Friday, with a scheduled working window of 8am–6pm UK time, including agreed breaks. You must be available to follow UK local time throughout the year.



Your day will generally be structured around:



* 8am–9am: reviewing recent financial activity, reconciling payments, recording invoices and identifying outstanding actions.

* 9am–5pm: property communications, booking conversions, payment chasing and ongoing administration, with scheduled breaks.

* 5pm–6pm: completing financial records, preparing approval requests and providing a clear daily handover.



You will remain available for urgent guest issues during the finance sessions. Time-sensitive booking invoices and payment links should be handled promptly throughout the day.



Your responsibilities will include:



1. Property communications



* Manage messages and calls from guests, HMO tenants, prospective customers, landlords, suppliers and contractors.

* Read the full conversation and booking history before replying, addressing every question or concern raised.

* Manage enquiries, pre-arrival requirements, check-in support, extensions and checkout communication.

* Check required guest information, rental agreements, payments and security deposits before releasing access instructions.

* Handle routine tenant enquiries, rent reminders, maintenance reports and access arrangements.

* Coordinate with our cleaning and maintenance team, keep people informed and follow up until there is a confirmed outcome.

* Maintain accurate notes, outstanding tasks and handovers.

* Escalate urgent problems and matters requiring director approval.



2. Direct bookings and sales follow-up



* Understand prospective guests’ dates, requirements and budget.

* Recommend suitable properties and provide accurate quotes using approved rates and terms.

* Follow up enquiries, quotations and payment links by message,
 or telephone.

* Answer questions confidently and help interested guests complete their bookings.

* Identify extension and repeat-booking opportunities.

* Keep an enquiry tracker showing the next action, follow-up date and outcome.

* Track opportunities through to confirmed, paid bookings.



3. Finance and administration



* Record new invoices and receipts the same working day.

* Allocate income and expenses to the correct property, company and reporting period.

* Create and check booking, extension, rent and other business invoices.

* Chase unpaid balances and maintain accurate payment records.

* Match reservations, platform payouts, payment-processor transactions and bank receipts.

* Investigate discrepancies, missing payments and duplicate entries.

* Check supplier invoices against agreed charges and completed work.

* Maintain property bills, deposit, refund and expense trackers.

* Prepare property income and expense summaries and supporting information for management and investor reporting.

* Organise financial documents and prepare clear payment and approval requests for the directors.



You must work within agreed approval limits. Payments, refunds, deductions, discounts and other financial commitments must follow the permissions given to you.



We are looking for someone who:



* Has hands-on experience in guest or property communications and bookkeeping or finance administration.

* Can demonstrate experience following up enquiries and securing bookings or sales.

* Writes clear, natural English and is confident speaking on the telephone.

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets or Excel and accounting software such as QuickBooks.

* Notices inconsistencies, checks their work and asks for clarification when needed.

* Can manage several open tasks while keeping priorities and deadlines clear.

* Takes feedback professionally, corrects mistakes and applies what they have learned.

* Takes ownership, reports blockers early and follows through reliably.

* Has a reliable computer, internet connection, calling setup and backup arrangements.



Experience with Hostaway, Airbnb, 
 and UK HMO administration would be an advantage.



You will begin with a structured finance handover, shadowing our existing administrator and completing supervised tasks. Communications responsibilities will be introduced in stages as you learn our properties and demonstrate accuracy.



We will train you in our systems and procedures. You should already have the core communication, sales follow-up and finance skills required for the role.



To apply, use the subject line “Property Communications & Finance” and include:



1. Your CV and a brief explanation of your relevant experience.

2. The property, communication and accounting systems you have used.

3. An example of an enquiry you helped convert into a confirmed booking or sale.

4. An example of a financial discrepancy you identified and resolved.

5. Confirmation that you can work the stated UK schedule, your earliest start date and your expected monthly salary in USD.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short practical assessment covering communication, booking follow-up, prioritisation and financial accuracy.



We’re looking for someone we can trust to take ownership, communicate thoughtfully and grow with our business.

title: E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)
description:
E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Michelle, Operations.



IF YOU'VE EVER CAUGHT A BAD FLAT FILE BEFORE IT WENT LIVE, READ ON

The inventory file says one number, the warehouse says another, and the upload is due in the morning. Most people upload and hope. We're looking for the person who stops, traces the gap to its source, and fixes it first.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll own the accuracy of everything we put on a marketplace and every number we report on: available-to-sell and inventory files, listings on Amazon, Shopify and our retail partners, our daily sales and ads reports, and the orders, returns and customer messages that follow. You'll be our warehouse's main contact, and you'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Inventory and available-to-sell files: keep one master product sheet as the source, reconcile inventory and ATS files for SKU, UPC and quantity before every upload, and check them live after. That includes Amazon, Shopify, our retail portals, and our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs.

• Listings: launches, price updates, retired SKUs, flat files and approved promotions, plus a weekly check for suppressed or rejected listings.

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag what doesn't add up.

• Orders, returns and the warehouse: keep orders moving, check the returns, files and invoices our warehouse sends, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims.

• Production support: prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs for our weekly production meeting.

• Tickets and SOPs: follow every Seller Support and portal ticket until it's fixed, and write down every step you own.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• Hands-on listing work for a brand or seller: Amazon flat files, Seller Central, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• 2+ years reconciling inventory, orders, invoices or e-commerce reports for someone else to act on.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances, and you can show where every figure came from.

• Customer care for an online brand, written warmly and clearly.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a 3PL.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every upload matches the master sheet, and nothing goes live with an open question.

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every open ticket and vendor issue has a next step.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.

title: AI Marketing Content Operator
description:
SB is hiring a sharp, self-starting content operator to turn the CEO's ideas into polished daily posts, articles, and videos, using AI tools at every step.



About the role

You work directly with Jeff, CEO of SB, a cybersecurity assessment firm founded in 2011 and headquartered in Texas. Jeff is the subject expert. You are the engine that gets his thinking published every day.

• The content is Jeff's personal brand first. Most posts go out as Jeff on his own LinkedIn, then get cross-posted to SB's channels.

• Jeff supplies the substance. Drafts reach you 80 to 90 percent complete. You add the hook, the polish, the format, the branding, and the video.

• The topics are technical and executive-level. Think cybersecurity compliance and running a business, not lifestyle content.

• The standard is high-end. SB's image is precise, upbeat, and professional. Close enough is not acceptable, and neither is anything that looks AI-generated.

• AI is your main tool. You're expected to use AI for research, drafting, editing, graphics, and video, and to apply the judgment that AI lacks.



What you do

The role has four parts, and you need to be capable in all four.

• Research and idea sourcing

    ◦ Track current events, industry news, and regulatory changes, and recommend timely topics.

    ◦ Watch what competitors, partners, and industry voices are saying, so Jeff stays current and relevant.

    ◦ Bring Jeff a short list of content ideas every day.

    ◦ Maintain a prioritized list of content ideas.

• Writing and polish

    ◦ Turn near-final drafts into finished blogs, articles, and posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

    ◦ Help write strong hooks and headlines, tighten wording, and fix every error.

    ◦ Adapt one idea into the right format for each platform.

• Video and graphics

    ◦ Take raw video recordings on Riverside or other tools and produce edited, captioned clips.

    ◦ Create branded graphics and thumbnails with AI tools, at a professional standard.

• Publishing and LinkedIn management

    ◦ Schedule and publish approved content every day.

    ◦ Monitor Jeff's LinkedIn feed and flag what matters.

    ◦ Find and connect with relevant people in adjacent industries.

    ◦ Over time, reply to comments and direct messages in Jeff's voice, and escalate anything you're unsure about.



What you bring

Required:

• High intelligence and fast learning. The subject matter is complex. You don't need to know Cybersecurity, Compliance, or Defense info but you need to pick up technical topics quickly.

• Technical curiosity. Cybersecurity and technology interest you. If these topics bore you, this role is not a fit.

• Extreme attention to detail. You catch the typo, the off-brand color, and the wrong date before anyone else sees them.

• Initiative. If you're unsure, you make your best attempt and bring it for feedback. You don't wait to be told what to do.

• High energy. You bring ideas, ask questions, and push the work forward.

• Careful listening. You take detailed notes, and feedback given once stays fixed.

• Excellent written English. You write and edit at a professional, near-native level.

• Good spoken English. You can speak English well enough to be understood easily.

• Daily, hands-on AI use. You use tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as part of how you work, and you can tell good output from generic output.

• Social media fluency. You know how LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube differ and what performs on each.

• Basic video and design skills. You can edit short-form video and produce clean, branded graphics.



Helpful but not required:

• Experience with Riverside, Canva, or Capcut.

• Experience ghostwriting or managing social media for an executive

• Background in technology, cybersecurity, or business-to-business marketing



How we work

• Hours: Full-time. You must be online from 7 AM to 2 PM US Central time, Monday through Friday. Most content is created and published in the morning.

• Location: Fully remote, US, Philipines, or South America. Skills matter more than location.

• Approvals: Jeff reviews and approves every piece before it publishes. After your work consistently needs no changes (expect three to six months), you earn the right to publish independently.

• Training: Jeff trains you on his voice, style, and standards. You're expected to learn them quickly and apply them without reminders.

• Success at 90 days: We publish high-quality content every day, in at least one format, without chasing anyone.



Pay and terms

• Pay: Based on skill and experience.

• Type: Contractor or employee, depending on your location.

• Trial: Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid trial project.



How to apply

Send the following. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.

1.  Your resume or CV.

2.  A two-minute video of you explaining any technical topic of your choice to a business executive. 

3.  Two or three samples of content you produced (posts, articles, graphics, or video clips), with a note on which AI tools you used and how.

4.  A one-paragraph answer: Which executive/expert posts on LinkedIn really well, and what makes it work well?

We're an established and growing cleaning company based in Colorado, USA. We connect residential clients with independent cleaning service providers and have a dedicated team supporting sales, scheduling, client experience and contractor operations.



We're looking for an experienced Contractor Operations & Recruitment Manager to help us build and maintain a reliable network of cleaning business partners.

Problem-Solving & Issue Resolution

Contractor Operations & Planning

* Monitor contractor availability, capacity and upcoming service commitments.

* Review contractor performance and recommend improvements.

* Identify opportunities to improve processes and prevent repeated problems.



Our Scheduling team handles booking assignments and replacement coverage. Your responsibility is to manage the contractor side of operations and make sure the team has accurate information to make decisions.



Who We're Looking For:



We're looking for someone who:



* Has at least 2–3 years of relevant experience in operations, recruitment, vendor management or service provider coordination.

* Has excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

* Is organized, detail-oriented and consistently follows through.

* Can prioritize tasks and make sound decisions when multiple issues need attention.

* Thinks ahead and recognizes potential problems before they escalate.

* Is comfortable having difficult conversations and holding business partners accountable.

* Can investigate situations objectively rather than jumping to conclusions.

* Takes initiative and doesn't need constant reminders or direction.

* Enjoys building relationships and helping a business grow.

* Is comfortable learning new systems and processes.



Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is strongly preferred.



Experience in cleaning services, home services, property management, staffing or other service-based businesses is a plus.

We're not looking for someone who simply completes tasks and checks them off a list.

When something goes wrong, you take the initiative to understand what happened, determine the next steps and make sure the situation is properly resolved.



When you notice the same problem happening repeatedly, you look for ways to prevent it rather than waiting for it to happen again.



And when you need to have a difficult conversation, you can be kind and understanding while still being clear about expectations.



We don't expect you to know everything on your first day. We'll provide training on our internal systems and processes.



What matters most is your judgment, communication, accountability and willingness to learn.
