title: eCommerce Operations Assistant
description:
eCommerce Operations Assistant Wanted.



We are in need of a skilled eCommerce Operations Assistant who is highly organized, execution-focused, and systems-minded — someone who can serve as a dependable right hand to our eCommerce Project Manager and keep our fulfillment operations running smoothly.



This person will support our eCommerce Project Manager directly across order fulfillment, Shopify operations, inventory management, promotions support, and ongoing workflow systems.



Someone who can successfully complete all of the following responsibilities without the Project Manager having to follow up (to see if they were done correctly or done at all) or step in and do them themselves.



The eCommerce Operations Assistant Will:

1. Check and triage the Project Manager’s inbox, flagging what needs response, action, or review

2. Draft email responses for the Project Manager’s review

3. Monitor Shopify orders and order holds in ShipHero, flagging any issues

4. Maintain and update Asana tasks and projects

5. Organize Google Drive files and folders

6. Surface items that require the Project Manager’s attention, decision, or approval

7. Prepare weekly meeting agendas, attend weekly planning meetings, take notes, and track action items with deadlines

8. Pull and input KPI data into reporting sheets monthly

9. Build discounts in Shopify and assist with promotions execution

10. Update product pages and draft new product listings in Shopify

11. Input purchase orders into ShipHero and maintain the inventory planning sheet

12. Maintain and update SOPs as workflows evolve

13. Use AI tools to improve systems, streamline processes, and build automation ideas



About the Role:

This is a fully remote part-time position requiring 20–25 hours per week to start, with the option to increase to full-time (35–40 hours).



Pay is $6–$7/hour depending on experience. There will be a two-month trial period on a graduated pay scale: you will start at $4.50–$5/hour and receive an additional $0.50/hour increase each month until reaching full pay once you successfully complete your probationary period. After a 6-month performance review, we will determine an increase in pay to $7–$8/hour.



Working hours are 10am–2pm EST. Must be available for the Weekly Planning Meeting on Mondays at 3pm ET (approximately 1 hour). You will have PTO for national and special Philippine holidays, plus 10 days/year of PTO if the role becomes full-time.



Are You the Right Fit?



Ask yourself:



Are you exceptionally organized and able to manage multiple moving parts at once?

Are you strong at follow-through and not satisfied with tasks sitting unfinished?

Are you comfortable with recurring systems and routines, including checklists, SOPs, and repeatable workflows?

Do you thrive in spreadsheet-heavy environments and enjoy working with data and KPIs?

Are you experienced inside an eCommerce business (not just customer support)?

Are you confident using Shopify at an execution level?

Are you comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT to improve workflows and efficiency?



If so, please read through the entire job announcement before applying.



About 
:

Quell Shop is a skincare and supplements brand built around a root-cause approach to chronic skin conditions. We are a small, focused team operating a growing eCommerce business and fulfillment operation. This role is an integral part of keeping our day-to-day operations running accurately and efficiently.



Our Tech Stack:

Since you will need to work efficiently on assigned tasks with little assistance, ideally you will have working knowledge of products in our tech stack. If not, we will provide training. However, you MUST be willing to use Google and YouTube to learn the software required for your job.



GSuite products (especially Google Sheets — strong proficiency is non-negotiable)

Shopify (execution level required)

ShipHero

Asana

Klaviyo

Kajabi

Canva

Gorgias (limited/backup)

Voxer

ChatGPT / AI tools (required competency)



Of the qualified applicants, we will prioritize those with more familiarity with our tech stack.



Requirements:

Strong Google Sheets proficiency (non-negotiable)

Prior experience working inside an eCommerce business (beyond customer support)

Experience with Shopify at an execution level

Comfortable with structured workflows and SOPs

Strong written and verbal English communication skills (C1 on the CEFR framework)

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, etc.)

Able to work efficiently with little supervision (we will provide initial training)

Detail-oriented, highly organized, and proactive

Tech-savvy and a resourceful self-learner



How to Apply:

If your interest is piqued, please reply to this job post and do the following:



1. Include only your favorite ice cream flavor and the name of our shop in the subject line.

2. Tell us which software in our tech stack you already know how to use and your approximate proficiency on a scale of 1–10.

3. Do not send a resume.

4. Tell us whether or not you already have a day job.

5. Let us know how many hours you are available to work each week (e.g., 20, 25, 30).

6. Share a brief example of a time you maintained or improved a workflow or system in a previous role.



Your application will be disqualified if you email us directly or do not follow the instructions above.



Please only apply if you are super detail-oriented and beyond organized. You must have at least 2 years of work experience in an eCommerce operations or admin role for an online business.



We are looking to bring you on board and want you to be a part of our dynamic, small but growing team. We’re looking for you to grow with us!



We will consider applicants who successfully fulfill all criteria above.



Thank you for taking the time to apply.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Venom Motorsports | Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts
description:
We sell motorcycles, ATVs, and other powersports vehicles at Venom Motorsports. Our on-camera team shoots product demos, walkarounds, and scripted videos. We're looking for an experienced editor who can find the strongest moment in the footage and build a video people want to finish.



Say we film a walkaround and the best moment is the actor firing up the bike halfway through. You might open on the engine start, use the actor's best line to set up the story, then cut back to the details viewers came to see. That's the kind of judgment we want you to bring to each edit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Turn raw footage into vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

• Build strong openings, choose the best takes, and use B-roll and cutaways to keep the story moving.

• Add accurate English captions, clean up dialogue, and balance music and effects with sounds worth hearing, like the engine or the actor's delivery.

• Suggest alternate openings when the footage supports them, revise from feedback, and keep project files organized for handoff.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A portfolio of short-form edits that shows strong pacing and storytelling, especially with a presenter or a physical product.

• Good judgment about when to cut, when to let a moment breathe, and when to use graphics or effects.

• Reliable turnaround and clear communication. Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut are all welcome. Automotive or powersports work is a plus.



PAY & AVAILABILITY

$4–$5 USD per hour, based on your portfolio and experience. Remote, Philippines-based. Share your weekly availability when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Send direct links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited. Include one presenter-led or product video if you have one, and tell us what parts of each edit you handled.

2. Pick one of those videos. In 2–3 sentences, explain why you opened it the way you did and one cut or sound choice that kept it moving.

3. Tell us your editing software, weekly availability, and how long you typically need to deliver a first cut of a 30–60 second video.



EDITING EXERCISE FOR SHORTLISTED APPLICANTS

We’ll ask shortlisted applicants to turn one clip from Venom Motorsports into a 15–30 second vertical video (9:16). Choose the opening yourself, trim the footage so the story moves, and keep any dialogue clear with easy-to-read captions. We’ll look at what you chose to open with, what you cut, and how you used sound.



Source footage: 



Send your portfolio first. If you’re shortlisted, we’ll confirm the details before you start the exercise.

title: Zoho CRM Developer & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Teal Bay Capital is looking for a hands-on **Zoho CRM & Digital Marketing Specialist** to customize our Zoho environment, connect website and marketing activity to our commercial funding pipeline, and use AI to improve content creation and lead follow-up.



**What you’ll do**



- **Zoho CRM and Zoho One.** Configure deal stages, custom fields, permissions, workflows, integrations, and dashboards. Route website inquiries and referrals to the right team member for follow-up.

- **Base44.** Maintain website pages and intake forms. Test changes to confirm that inquiries reach Zoho with the correct lead source and assignment.

- **AI, Pressmaster, and social media.** Use AI and Pressmaster to research topics, draft and repurpose content, and maintain a publishing calendar. Review content for accuracy and brand consistency before it goes through approval.

- **RankGPT and Traxy.** Use RankGPT to support search and AI visibility reporting. Help evaluate and implement Traxy, document how it fits into the marketing workflow, and track results.

- **Reporting.** Track inquiries, qualified opportunities, and funded deals by source so leadership can see which marketing efforts generate business.



**What you’ll bring**



- Strong, hands-on experience administering and customizing Zoho CRM. Experience with the broader Zoho One suite is strongly preferred. Be ready to walk through a workflow or integration you personally built and tested.

- Practical experience using AI tools and social media platforms for content creation, publishing, and performance reporting.

- A working understanding of Base44, Pressmaster, RankGPT, and Traxy. Hands-on experience with any of these platforms is preferred.

- Clear written English, attention to detail, and sound judgment when handling sensitive borrower information and public-facing financing content.



**Compensation and 90-day review**



Base salary is **$950–$1,200 USD per month, plus performance-based bonus opportunities**. The starting salary within that range will reflect your demonstrated Zoho and digital marketing experience. Bonus eligibility and criteria will be outlined in writing.



At the start of the role, we’ll agree on priorities and how we’ll measure success. At 90 days, we’ll review whether website inquiries are reliably captured and assigned in Zoho, qualified opportunities can be traced to their source, and approved content is published consistently. We’ll use that review to discuss performance, next priorities, and whether a base salary adjustment is warranted.

title: Client Onboarding Specialist (Customer Support)
description:
Every new client lead gets a real human within 30 minutes. The Client Onboarding Specialist is that human.



A brokerage launching in APAC is hiring its first Client Onboarding Specialist. This person is the first point of contact for every new client.



Responsibilities:

- Book and run a 30-minute onboarding session on Zoom, with screen share

- Get KYC submitted on the call and fix rejections fast

- Follow up until the client makes a first deposit and first trade

- Act as the client's go-to contact for the first 30 days and escalate issues to the right team the same day

- Log every call, message and booking in the CRM the same day

- Report the questions clients ask most so the team can improve the product and content



Requirements:

- More than 3 years of experience in a related field (customer onboarding, customer success, client service or inside sales)

- Experience onboarding customers on Zoom

- Good spoken and written English

- Comfortable calling new leads quickly, and explaining money topics simply

- Organised and disciplined with a CRM

- Brokerage, fintech or trading experience is a plus

- Mandarin, Bahasa Melayu or Bahasa Indonesia is a plus



Shifts follow lead flow and include evenings and a weekend rotation.



To apply, applicants should send a CV and a 60-second voice note explaining how a top-up bonus works to a first-time trader.

title: YouTube Thumbnail for B2C Info-Business Channels
description:
About Us

We work with B2C info businesses (coaches, course creators, and education-based brands) to grow their YouTube channels and paid acquisition. Our focus isn't chasing viral views — it's building watch time, trust, and conversions that turn viewers into customers, leads, and buyers. We're looking for a designer who understands that a thumbnail's job is to earn the click while staying true to the brand, not just look flashy.



INSPO OF THE STYLE WE ARE LOOKING FOR:









The Role

We need a graphic designer who specializes in YouTube thumbnails and can also support with related visual assets for our channels and campaigns.



Heads up on how this starts: we're beginning with a small, low-volume workload as a trial run. This isn't a red flag on the role — it's how we bring everyone in. Once we see the quality and reliability of your work and more trust is built, expect to receive more work on a consistent basis.



What You'll Be Doing



Designing custom YouTube thumbnails for long-form videos — high-CTR, on-brand, and tailored to what performs in the info-business/coaching space

Iterating on thumbnail concepts based on performance data or feedback (not just "make it pop," but understanding why something clicks)

Keeping a consistent visual identity across a channel's thumbnails so the brand is instantly recognizable

Supporting with occasional related graphics — channel art, end screens, social posts, or simple ad creative assets

Organizing and naming files clearly so assets are easy to find and reuse

Taking notes/feedback and turning revisions around quickly and without back-and-forth



What We're Looking For



Proven experience designing YouTube thumbnails specifically — not just general graphic design with no YouTube portfolio

An eye for what drives clicks in the B2C/coaching/course-creator space: clear value proposition, strong facial expressions/emotion, legible text, and contrast — without looking clickbait-y or cheap

Strong skills in Photoshop, Canva, or similar design tools

Understanding of what makes content convert (clarity, credibility, curiosity) vs. what's just "viral bait" — we care about the former

Ability to work from a brand style guide and keep visual consistency across many thumbnails over time

Reliable communicator, meets deadlines, takes direction well on revisions

Strong English communication skills

Comfortable starting with a lighter initial workload that grows as trust and consistency are established



Nice to Have



Experience designing for coaches, consultants, course creators, or other info-business/education-based brands specifically

Basic understanding of A/B testing thumbnails or using YouTube Studio analytics to inform design choices

Experience with other supporting design work — channel banners, social graphics, or simple ad creatives

Basic video editing skills (not required, but a plus)



To Apply

Please send:



A portfolio showing YouTube thumbnails specifically — ideally with the videos/channels they were made for, so we can see them in context

Your typical turnaround time per thumbnail/batch

Your rate (open to proposals — tell us how you'd structure it: per thumbnail, hourly, or monthly retainer). Note that we're starting with a lower volume and scaling based on quality, so flexibility on early workload is a plus



We're looking to build a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

 using footage supplied by our team. • Create attractive social media graphics and photo-based posts consistent with each brand’s identity.

 applications directly. Include your resume, links to 3–5 Reels or short videos you personally edited, your editing software, availability, and proposed hourly or per-deliverable rate. Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief paid editing test using sample footage.

title: E-Commerce Video Editor & AI Content Creator
description:
E-Commerce Video Editor & AI Content Creator (Full-Time, Remote)



We’re a fast-growing US e-commerce brand, and we’re hiring a skilled video editor who also generates AI content — with one thing to be great at: creating DTC ads that stop the scroll and drive sales.



You already know how to cut high-performing e-commerce video. Here, you’ll pair that craft with the newest AI generation tools to produce ad content that’s faster to make, sharper, and at a scale most brands can’t match. This is where performance creative is heading, and you’ll be right at the front of it.



And you won’t be editing in a vacuum. You’ll join a small, hard-working team that treats content as the engine of the business. We move fast, we test relentlessly, and we obsess over quality. If you’re hungry to get genuinely great at this craft, this is the place to do it.



Compensation: $1,000–$1,600/month base, plus performance bonuses — with total earnings up to $2,500/month for strong performers. Raises as you grow.

Schedule: Full-time, remote.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US



A real growth path. We promote from within. Prove yourself and you can grow into a senior creative role with more ownership and responsibility.

Mentorship from people who do this at a high level. You’ll learn directly from experienced marketers and creators, not figure it out alone.

In-house training courses so you keep sharpening your skills and stay ahead of the field.

A team of dedicated people who take pride in their work and back each other up.

A stable, long-term role with a brand that’s scaling fast.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Edit and assemble high-performing DTC video ads in CapCut — this is your bread and butter.

Produce AI-generated video content daily using tools like Kling, Seedance, Sora, and Veo (and whatever’s newest).

Create AI-generated image assets to support our ad campaigns.

Follow creative briefs and SOPs to deliver consistent, on-brand output.

Stay on top of the latest AI generation tools and techniques, and bring new ideas to the team.

Collaborate with the team and contribute creative direction, not just execution.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



2+ years editing video for e-commerce / DTC brands — this is the core of the role and non-negotiable.

At least 6 months creating AI-generated video and image content.

Hands-on experience with AI tools like Kling, Sora, Seedance, or Nano Banana Pro (or similar / the latest versions).

Strong CapCut editing and post-production skills.

A sharp eye for quality and real attention to detail.

Able to work independently in a remote setting and consistently hit daily output.

Good written and spoken English.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill out our short application form:

Include your portfolio: share your 2–3 best ads you’ve ever made — and tell us what brand they were for. No portfolio means we can’t consider you, so make sure to include your best work.

To prove you actually read this post, start your application message with the word “CINEMATIC”. Applications without it won’t be reviewed.



We read every application that follows these three steps. If you’re talented and driven, we’d love to see what you can do.

title: Virtual Medical Receptionist – Chiropractic Office (Remote | Philippines)
description:
# Virtual Medical Receptionist & Sales Specialist (Remote | Philippines)



We are a growing chiropractic practice in the United States seeking a friendly, confident, and sales-driven Virtual Receptionist to join our team.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with people, has excellent English communication skills, and knows how to turn phone inquiries into booked appointments.



**This is more than a traditional receptionist position. A large part of the role involves sales, so we are looking for someone who can confidently answer questions, overcome objections, and encourage prospective patients to schedule their first visit.**



### Key Responsibilities



- Answer incoming phone calls in a friendly, professional, and welcoming manner.

- Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments.

- Answer questions about chiropractic services, pricing, promotions, and appointment availability.

- Convert incoming inquiries into booked new-patient appointments.

- Confidently address concerns and objections from prospective patients.

- Follow up with missed calls and potential patients who have not yet scheduled.

- Maintain accurate patient information and appointment records.

- Provide excellent customer service to both new and existing patients.



### Qualifications



- Excellent spoken and written English with clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation.

- Previous experience in phone sales, appointment setting, customer service, or medical reception.

- Strong sales skills with the ability to confidently close appointments.

- Friendly, outgoing personality and a positive attitude.

- Comfortable handling objections and speaking with prospective patients who may be hesitant to book.

- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace.

- Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Experience with chiropractic offices, medical scheduling, or healthcare services is a plus.



### Compensation & Incentives



- Competitive hourly pay based on experience.

- **Additional performance-based incentives for successfully converted new-patient appointments.**

- Opportunity to earn more based on sales performance.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based healthcare practice.



### How to Apply



**IMPORTANT: Applications must include an audio recording of your voice.**



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume and relevant work experience.

2. Your desired hourly rate in USD.

3. A short audio recording (approximately 60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining your experience with phone sales, customer service, or appointment scheduling.

4. In your recording, briefly demonstrate how you would respond to a potential patient who calls asking about pricing but is hesitant to schedule an appointment.



**Applications without an audio recording will not be considered.**



We are looking for someone who can make patients feel comfortable, build trust quickly, and confidently turn conversations into appointments. If you have a great phone personality and enjoy sales, we would love to hear from you!

title: Customer Support Specialist | Shopify Dropshipping Experience Required
description:
We run several online women’s fashion stores serving customers in Canada, Australia and Europe. We are looking for a full-time customer support specialist with direct experience handling customer emails for a Shopify dropshipping store.



Previous Shopify dropshipping customer support experience is required. Experience with women’s fashion dropshipping stores is strongly preferred.



ABOUT THE JOB

Our system prepares most customer replies using approved templates. You are the human check: you read the conversation, compare the reply with the order details and tracking, correct errors according to our written policies, and send the right answer.

You also follow up with our fulfilment partner when orders are delayed or something goes wrong. We provide training on our systems and policies, but you should already understand the everyday customer service challenges of dropshipping.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Check and send customer replies about orders, delivery delays, sizing, returns and address changes.

- Verify order details, tracking updates, dates and amounts before sending.

- Follow up on delayed orders and problem cases with our fulfilment partner throughDiscord

- Ask customers for photos or additional information when needed.

- Follow our written policies and flag cases that need an owner’s decision.

- Keep clear case notes and follow up until each issue is resolved.

- Make sure no customer email waits longer than 24 hours for a response.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of customer support experience with Shopify dropshipping stores.

- Women’s fashion dropshipping experience is a strong advantage.

- Excellent written English.

- Experience handling shipping delays, tracking issues, sizing complaints, returns and refund requests.

- Strong attention to detail: you notice incorrect dates, amounts, products and tracking statuses.

- A calm, professional approach to upset customers.

- Ability to follow written procedures and work reliably without constant supervision.

- Stable internet, your own laptop and a quiet place to work.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Full time: 8 hours per day, at least 6 days per week.

- $4 USD per hour, approximately $830 per month based on 48 hours per week.

- Long-term position with training through written guides and videos.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with KIWI and answer every question below:

1. Which Shopify dropshipping stores have you worked for? Include the store names, website URLs, your role and the dates you worked there.

2. Did any of these stores sell women’s fashion? Which ones?

3. What customer support tasks did you personally handle, which tools did you use, and approximately how many tickets did you handle per day?

4. Describe one difficult customer case you personally resolved involving a delayed order, sizing complaint or return. What did you check, what action did you take, and what was the outcome?

5. Confirm that you are available for the schedule and hourly rate above. Include your time zone and earliest start date.



If a confidentiality agreement prevents you from naming a store, explain this and suggest another way to verify your experience. Please do not share customer information or confidential company records.

We will only consider applications that answer these questions and demonstrate relevant Shopify dropshipping customer support experience. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical assessment using fictional customer cases and our written policies.

title: AI CONTENT CREATOR & VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Hey 👋



I run an AI content agency. We make short form video using AI avatars, built with Veo and Flow, for our own brands and for clients across a few different markets.



Let me be honest about who I’m looking for



I’m not looking for someone who wants a job. I’m looking for someone who actually cares about the work.



The difference shows up fast. People who are just here for the money do the minimum, ignore feedback, and plateau. People who care get obsessed with why one video hits and another doesn’t, and they get better every single week.



I already have creators like that. They’re brilliant, they push each other, and they’ve built something I’m proud of. I’m only adding people who raise that standard, not dilute it.



If that sounds intense, it probably isn’t for you. If it sounds like what you’ve been looking for, keep reading.



What you’d actually do



Create short form videos using AI avatars, working from prompts and guides I provide.



Each video takes around an hour once you’re up to speed. The minimum is 2 videos a day per account, which works out at 14 a week. Finish them early and the rest of your week is yours.



What you get that you won’t get elsewhere



I share everything. Prompts, techniques, what’s working, what’s failing. I make the videos myself first so I hit the problems before you do.



We pioneer content in this space, so there’s often a new style to learn week to week. You’ll be building skills that barely exist in the market yet.



And you’ll be alongside creators who are genuinely good. That matters more than people realise.



The one fixed commitment



Sunday group calls, 7 PM Philippines time, every week. That’s where I give feedback and we level up together. It’s the single biggest reason our standard keeps climbing, so it isn’t optional.



What I need from you



Coachable. I give real feedback and we run proper revisions. If criticism stings rather than motivates, this won’t work.



Communicative. If you’re stuck, tell me. Don’t disappear and don’t guess.



Reliable. If you say it’s coming, it comes.



Quality over volume. I’d rather have one great video than three rushed ones.



The pay will be 3$ an hour as most videos takes around that time to make whilst learning new process and techniques, after a while the time frame should shrink within 30-45mins to make.



I’m telling you this early so nobody wastes their time.



How to apply



Tell me, in your own words:



- Why AI content genuinely interests you, not a textbook answer.

Something you’ve made with AI tools, even if it’s rough. Link it



- What you’re currently working on and how many hours you could commit



- How you handle feedback when someone tells you your work isn’t good enough yet

title: AI Video Editor: Long-Form AI Ads (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We’re a fast-growing US supplement brand running ads on Meta, TikTok, Amazon and TV. Most of our winning ads right now are long-form AI videos: drama stories, songs and Pixar-style animation. We need editors who can make them fast and well.



WHAT YOU NEED

- DTC ad experience. You know an ad exists to sell. You understand hooks, retention, pacing, how to show a problem and its payoff, and why the first 3 seconds d
 everything.

- Visuals that match the words. Every line of the script gets the visual that sells it best. You can’t fill a scene with something random just because it looks nice. And no AI slop: no warped faces or hands, and no characters who change from shot to shot.



THE JOB

- One AI-heavy video per day, up to 5 minutes long.

- 24-hour turnaround from brief to first cut.

- Revisions back the same day.

- You work in our Higgsfield account. We pay for all credits.

- Our creative strategists write every brief and script. You just make the video.



HOW WE WORK

- Transparency and honesty. We say things straight, both good and bad. If something is off, you’ll hear it from us directly, and we expect the same from you. Nobody talks behind anyone’s back.

- Respect. Everyone on the team gets treated with respect, every time.

- Solution focus. When you hit a problem, come with a few ways to fix it, not just the problem.

- Ownership. If it’s your job, it’s your responsibility, from brief to final cut.

- Team spirit. We help each other out. When one of us wins, we all win.



WHAT YOU GET

- Steady daily volume and long-term work.

- A bonus every time one of your ads becomes a winner.

- Access to the newest AI models as they come out.

- A path into creative strategy if you show you understand why ads win.



HOW TO APPLY

There are no calls or interviews. We hire on your application alone, so make it count.



1. Portfolio: links to long-form ads you made recently, 5–10 minutes each, in AI drama, AI song or Pixar-style formats. Send only that kind of work. Short clips, reels and YouTube edits will be skipped.

2. Loom video (2–3 min max):

   - A short summary of your experience.

   - Why you’re the best fit for this role.

   - Show a video you made recently and explain why you chose the visual you used for its hook.

3. Answer these in writing:

   - Which brands have you made ads for? Why did you leave each one?

   - How many credits do you usually use on a 5-minute AI-heavy video?

   - Which models do you use, and for what (characters, scenes, lip-sync, music)?

   - How much do you want to earn per month (USD)?



Applications missing any of the above won’t be reviewed.

title: Senior E-commerce Web Developer
description:
🚀 WE'RE HIRING: Senior E-commerce Web Developer | Shopify, Funnelish, Checkout Champ, AI Automation & Meta/Google Ads



Job Type: Full-Time / Long-Term  

Work Location: Remote 

Experience Level: Senior / Expert



## About the Role



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company looking for a highly experienced Senior E-commerce Web Developer with advanced expertise in Shopify, sales funnels, conversion rate optimization, AI automation, and digital advertising platforms.



We are NOT looking for a basic web developer, graphic designer, or someone who only knows how to use Shopify.



We need a true all-around e-commerce expert who can independently manage the entire technical and commercial ecosystem of an online store: from product pages and sales funnels to checkout optimization, post-purchase offers, automations, and advertising integrations.



The ideal candidate must have extensive knowledge of advanced e-commerce tools, execute tasks extremely quickly, and proactively identify opportunities to increase sales, conversions, and profitability.



Speed, independence, technical expertise, problem-solving, and execution are essential.



## 📌 Key Responsibilities



### 1. Shopify – Advanced Expertise



- Build, customize, manage, and optimize Shopify stores.

- Develop high-converting landing pages and product pages.

- Work with Shopify, PageFly, and other professional page builders.

- Customize Shopify themes, sections, and store functionality.

- Configure products, bundles, discounts, promotions, and special offers.

- Integrate third-party applications and external tools.

- Optimize website speed, mobile experience, and conversion rates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly.

- Implement custom functionality using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when necessary.



### 2. Funnelish & Checkout Champ – Advanced Funnel Development



We are specifically looking for someone with strong practical experience using Funnelish and Checkout Champ.



Responsibilities include:



- Building complete, high-converting sales funnels.

- Creating conversion-focused landing pages.

- Setting up and optimizing checkout pages.

- Implementing order bumps, upsells, downsells, and cross-sells.

- Building one-click post-purchase offers.

- Creating and optimizing post-purchase pages.

- Configuring funnels with multiple offers, bundles, and pricing strategies.

- Integrating funnels with Shopify and payment processors.

- Setting up tracking, conversion events, and attribution.

- Running A/B tests to improve funnel performance.

- Identifying and fixing checkout and funnel issues.



You must understand the complete customer journey, from the first ad click to checkout, purchase, and post-purchase offers.



### 3. AI Tools, Automation & Rapid Development



- Use AI-powered tools to build websites, landing pages, and funnels significantly faster.

- Create automations to streamline e-commerce operations.

- Work with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Make, n8n, Zapier, or equivalent platforms.

- Build integrations between Shopify, CRM systems, advertising platforms, and other business tools.

- Develop custom dashboards and internal business applications.

- Automate repetitive tasks and operational workflows.

- Use AI-assisted coding and development tools to accelerate execution.

- Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with reliable automations.



We want someone who genuinely knows how to leverage AI to execute projects much faster, not someone who simply uses ChatGPT to generate text.



### 4. Meta Business Manager & Google Ads



The candidate must have strong knowledge of digital advertising platforms, particularly:



Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads



- Manage Meta Business Manager and advertising accounts.

- Configure Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI).

- Set up events, domain verification, and conversion tracking.

- Create, configure, and manage advertising campaigns.

- Understand Sales, retargeting, and prospecting campaigns.

- Analyze advertising performance and campaign metrics.

- Troubleshoot tracking issues, account problems, and integration errors.



Google Ads



- Set up and manage Google Ads accounts.

- Understand Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns.

- Configure and manage Google Merchant Center.

- Implement conversion tracking.

- Integrate Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.

- Analyze ROAS, CPA, CPC, and other performance metrics.

- Identify tracking issues and optimization opportunities.



We are not necessarily looking for a dedicated media buyer. We need an e-commerce expert who understands advertising platforms, can work with campaigns independently, and can correctly manage all technical integrations and tracking systems.



### 5.
 Marketing & Customer Retention



- Build automated
 marketing campaigns and flows.

- Set up abandoned cart and abandoned checkout recovery sequences.

- Create post-purchase
 automations.

- Implement upsell and cross-sell
 campaigns.

- Build customer segmentation and retention workflows.

- Work with Klaviyo, Shopify
, or similar platforms.



### 6. Analytics, Profit & Loss Dashboards



- Build custom dashboards to monitor e-commerce performance.

- Integrate data from Shopify, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.

- Track revenue, advertising expenses, product costs, and shipping costs.

- Calculate profit margins, ROAS, CPA, and overall profitability.

- Create automated reporting systems.

- Monitor inventory levels and product availability.

- Develop internal tools to improve business decision-making.



### 7. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)



- Analyze and improve website conversion rates.

- Optimize product pages, landing pages, and checkout experiences.

- Identify friction points and drop-offs throughout the sales funnel.

- Implement A/B testing.

- Improve Average Order Value (AOV), conversion rate, and revenue per visitor.

- Proactively suggest improvements based on performance data.



## 🎯 Essential Requirements



- Extensive, proven experience in the e-commerce industry.

- Expert-level Shopify knowledge.

- Hands-on experience with Funnelish and/or Checkout Champ, ideally both.

- Strong experience building advanced sales funnels and post-purchase offers.

- Excellent knowledge of Meta Business Manager and Google Ads.

- Ability to configure pixels, conversion events, tracking systems, and integrations.

- Strong experience with AI development tools and automation platforms.

- Knowledge of
 marketing and customer retention systems.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Excellent technical problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong communication skills and reliable availability.

- Extremely fast execution without sacrificing quality.



We care much more about real-world skills, completed projects, measurable results, and execution speed than degrees or certifications.



## 🔥 The Ideal Candidate



We do not want someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task.



We are looking for someone who can receive an objective and independently:



- Identify the best technical solution.

- Select the most effective tools.

- Build and implement the project quickly.

- Test everything thoroughly.

- Deliver complete, professional, and functional results.

- Proactively recommend improvements to increase performance.



Our goal is to hire a highly specialized Senior E-commerce Web Developer who becomes the main technical and operational expert for our entire e-commerce ecosystem.



## 📩 How to Apply



To be considered, you must answer ALL the following questions



1. E-commerce Experience



How many years have you worked in e-commerce? Which brands or companies have you worked with?



2. Shopify Expertise



Rate your Shopify skills from 1 to 10. Share at least 2–3 Shopify stores or pages you personally developed.



3. Funnelish & Checkout Champ



Have you worked with Funnelish or Checkout Champ? Which platform do you know best? Share real examples of funnels you have built.



4. Post-Purchase Funnels



Do you have experience creating upsells, downsells, order bumps, and one-click post-purchase offers? Which tools have you used?



5. Meta Business Manager



What is your experience level with Meta Business Manager? Can you configure Meta Pixel, Conversions API, events, and advertising campaigns?



6. Google Ads



Do you have experience with Google Ads, Merchant Center, GA4, and Google Tag Manager? Have you configured or managed Search, Shopping, or Performance Max campaigns?



7. Artificial Intelligence



Which AI tools do you use daily? Share specific examples of websites, automations, dashboards, or applications you have built using AI.



8.
 Marketing



Which
 marketing platforms have you worked with? Have you built automated flows for abandoned checkouts, post-purchase sequences, and customer retention?



9. Profit & Loss Dashboards



Have you ever built a dashboard that automatically calculates e-commerce revenue, advertising expenses, operational costs, and net profit?



10. Execution Speed



How long would it realistically take you to:



- Build a complete Shopify landing page?

- Create a sales funnel with checkout, upsells, and downsells?

- Set up a post-purchase funnel?

- Build a fully functional Shopify store?

- Create a P&L dashboard integrated with Shopify and Meta Ads?



11. Availability



How many hours per day and days per week are you available? Can you start immediately?



12. Skills Self-Assessment



Rate your skills from 1 to 10 in each of the following areas:



- Shopify

- Funnelish

- Checkout Champ

- Landing Pages & CRO

- Meta Business Manager

- Google Ads

- AI Website Building

- AI Automation

-
 Marketing

- Analytics & P&L Dashboards



13. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in USD for a full-time position?



14. Why Should We Hire You?



Explain what makes you more skilled, faster, and more effective than other candidates. Provide concrete examples of your work and achievements.



## ⚠️ Important



**This position is strictly for professionals with advanced, proven e-commerce experience.**



We are not looking for beginners, generic web developers, or people who only understand the basic features of Shopify.



We have multiple ongoing projects and are looking for a long-term team member who can take ownership of technical projects, work independently, and directly contribute to our company's growth.



**Please do not submit generic or entirely AI-generated applications without real examples of your work.**



We want to see actual portfolios, working projects, demonstrable technical expertise, and realistic delivery times.



**If you are a true e-commerce expert, have advanced Shopify and funnel-building skills, know how to leverage AI, understand Meta and Google advertising platforms, and can execute extremely quickly, we want to hear from you.**

title: Appointment Setter/Outbound Calling Specialist
description:
Five Star Bath Solutions of Sioux Falls



Remote  |  $5.00 USD/hour + performance bonuses  |  40 hours/week  |  Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central  |  Initial 60-day paid pilot



About Our Company

Five Star Bath Solutions of Sioux Falls is a growing bathroom remodeling company serving homeowners throughout South Dakota, Nebraska, Iowa, and Minnesota. We specialize in walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, and bathtub replacements.



About the Position

 

This is a phone-intensive sales support position—not a general virtual assistant role. We generate approximately 300 new leads per month. Your job is to respond quickly, connect with homeowners, qualify their needs, and schedule appointments. Speed-to-lead is a top priority. Expect approximately 100–200 outbound call attempts daily depending on lead volume and campaign activity.



Primary Responsibilities

• Respond promptly to new leads during working hours, prioritizing speed-to-lead

• Make approximately 100–200 outbound call attempts per day

• Qualify interested homeowners and schedule in-home sales appointments

• Follow up with unresponsive leads, event prospects, and older inquiries

• Confirm appointments and help reduce cancellations and no-shows

• Accurately record call outcomes and customer details in the CRM

• Coordinate appointment information with the sales team

• Track daily activity, contacts, qualified appointments, and appointment attendance

• Follow company procedures and honor opt-out requests



English Communication Requirements:

Exceptional spoken English is essential. Our customers are primarily Midwestern U.S. homeowners. You must speak fluent, easily understood conversational English; listen carefully; build rapport naturally; handle objections without relying entirely on a script; and communicate comfortably with older American homeowners. Prior outbound calling experience with U.S. customers is strongly preferred.



Required Qualifications:

• Proven outbound calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or inside-sales experience

• Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers

• Comfortable with high call volume and frequent unanswered calls

• Strong objection-handling, organization, and follow-up skills

• Reliable internet, computer, quality headset, and quiet workspace

• Ability to work Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central, adjusting for daylight saving time

s.

You'll help grow our organic search presence, search rankings, and online authority across multiple consumer health brands.

- Identify digital PR, expert contribution, and content promotion opportunities

- Monitor reviews, Reddit, forums, and other online conversations around our brands and industry

- Help manage citations, profiles, directories, and other offsite brand assets

- Research potential influencers, affiliates, creators, and partnership opportunities

- Maintain organized outreach pipelines, follow-ups, and placement records

- Track SEO improvements, outreach performance, and acquired backlinks

- Use AI and modern SEO tools to research faster, identify opportunities, and improve the quality of your work



## Requirements



- **At least 2 years of hands-on SEO experience**, ideally involving both on-page SEO and link building

- Proven experience conducting outreach and acquiring quality backlinks or guest-post placements

- Good understanding of keyword research, competitor analysis, and on-page/off-page SEO

- Ability to evaluate backlink quality and relevance rather than focusing only on link quantity

- Strong research skills and attention to detail

- Strong written English and professional outreach communication skills

- Comfortable reaching out to websites, publishers, creators, and potential partners

- Able to stay organized while managing multiple opportunities, campaigns, and follow-ups

- Comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and owning results

- Interested in learning and testing new SEO and digital marketing strategies

- Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow



## Experience That Is a Plus



Experience with any of the following is helpful, but you do not need to know everything:



- Google Search Console

- Ahrefs or Semrush

- WordPress

- Google Analytics

- Link-building and outreach tools

- Reddit and online community research

- Guest posting, editorial outreach, or digital PR

- Influencer or affiliate outreach

- Local SEO and citation management

- SEO experience with healthcare, wellness, or other competitive consumer industries



## Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, resourceful, and results-oriented.



You should be the type of person who can look at a website, search result, competitor, backlink profile, or online conversation and immediately start identifying opportunities.



We value people who take initiative, communicate clearly, stay organized, and continually look for smarter ways to improve results.



**Most importantly, we're looking for someone who can execute.** Someone who doesn't just identify opportunities but actively pursues them, follows up, and helps deliver meaningful SEO improvements.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief overview of your SEO and link-building experience. A

2. **Two or three examples of backlinks, guest posts, or outreach placements you've helped secure**, including the websites if available.

3. The SEO tools you regularly use and what you use them for.

4. A short video introduction with an explanation of how you determine whether a website is worth pursuing for a backlink. This way we can gauge your communication



We value real experience and practical thinking more than certificates or lengthy resumes.

title: Part-Time Three.js / Full-Stack Web Developer — Interactive Science Education Platform

Compensation: $10–$18 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated experience

About Kiku Learning



Kiku Learning is a developing online science and healthcare education platform designed to make challenging subjects easier to understand through interactive learning, realistic 3D laboratories, clinical scenarios, visual explanations, and meaningful connections between scientific concepts.



Our goal is to create an academically rigorous but engaging learning experience for students pursuing nursing, medicine, allied health, and other science-related fields.



The platform is already under active development. We are not starting from scratch.



We currently have an established website with course content, learning units, interactive educational features, and several working 3D laboratory prototypes. Our existing work includes:



Mount Kiku, an interactive 3D mountain expedition that connects calculus, slopes, derivatives, elevation, weather, and optimization.



Evolution Island, an ecosystem and evolutionary biology simulation.



A 3D nephron learning experience.



An interactive human heart anatomy viewer with external and cross-sectional models.



Additional anatomy, pharmacology, clinical education, and student learning tools.



Our development workflow currently uses AI-assisted coding, GitHub, Cloudflare, and Three.js.



We are seeking a skilled developer who can take ownership of the technical implementation, improve the quality of existing features, and help us expand our interactive learning experiences.



Responsibilities



Review and understand our existing codebase and website architecture.



Improve and maintain existing functionality without unnecessary redesigns.



Integrate professional 3D models, animations, and interactive environments into the website.



Work with Three.js, WebGL, GLB/glTF files, textures, lighting, and shaders.



Improve realistic movement, camera controls, navigation, and student interaction in 3D labs.



Optimize website and 3D performance for desktop, tablets, and mobile devices.



Troubleshoot technical issues and implement well-tested fixes.



Collaborate with a 3D artist to integrate custom assets.



Maintain clean, documented code and safe GitHub development workflows.



Test changes in staging before production deployment.



Help translate educational concepts into engaging, functional simulations.



Required Qualifications



Demonstrable experience with JavaScript and modern web development.



Experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber, Babylon.js, or comparable browser-based 3D technology; direct Three.js experience strongly preferred.



Ability to work with GitHub and existing codebases.



Understanding of 3D model loading, optimization, lighting, and rendering.



Experience with responsive websites and performance optimization.



Strong problem-solving ability and clear English communication.



Ability to work independently and explain technical decisions to a nontechnical founder.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with Blender and 3D asset pipelines.



Experience with Cloudflare deployment.



Experience creating interactive educational tools, simulations, games, or scientific visualizations.



Familiarity with physics-based interactions, mathematical visualization, or animation.



Experience collaborating with AI-assisted development workflows.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who is creative, technically capable, reliable, and genuinely interested in building meaningful educational technology.



You do not need to be a medical professional or a science educator. Scientific content and anatomy will undergo separate subject-matter review.



We value thoughtful solutions, honest communication, and preserving the work that is already functioning.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume and portfolio or GitHub profile.



Links to two or three interactive websites, 3D applications, or simulations you personally developed.



A brief explanation of your experience with Three.js or similar technology.



Your hourly rate and weekly availability.



Your experience with existing codebases and AI-assisted development tools.



Application question: How would you improve the visual realism and free movement of an existing Three.js mountain simulation without breaking its current mathematics and learning features?



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small, paid technical assessment.



We look forward to meeting developers who want to help build the next generation of interactive science education.

Long-Term Growth & Career Opportunities



Kiku Learning is an early-stage educational technology company with ambitious plans for growth. Our vision extends beyond creating a traditional learning website. We are developing a comprehensive, interactive science and healthcare education platform designed to serve students across multiple disciplines and potentially around the world.



Although this position will begin as part-time, flexible, and project-based, we are looking for individuals who may be interested in growing with the company long-term.



As Kiku Learning develops, expands its curriculum, launches additional interactive laboratories, and grows its subscriber base, there may be opportunities for:



Transitioning into a full-time position with a more structured schedule and established compensation.



Increased hourly compensation based on responsibilities, performance, company growth, and available funding.



Advancement into senior, lead, or management roles as the technical and creative teams expand.



Taking ownership of larger projects, new learning experiences, and future platform developments.



Becoming a long-term member of Kiku Learning's core development team.

title: Part-Time 3D Artist / Blender Generalist — Realistic Science, Anatomy & Simulation Assets
description:
Company: Kiku Learning

Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Flexible, part-time or project-based, approximately 5–10 hours per week when projects are active

Compensation: $8–$15 USD/hour initially, negotiable based on portfolio and specialized experience

Engagement: As-needed projects with opportunities for ongoing collaboration



About Kiku Learning



Kiku Learning is an emerging science and healthcare education platform combining comprehensive academic lessons with interactive 3D laboratories, realistic scientific environments, and clinical learning experiences.



We are building an educational platform where students can explore scientific concepts rather than simply read about them.



Our existing projects include:



Mount Kiku: a realistic mountain expedition used to teach calculus, gradients, optimization, and scientific reasoning.



Evolution Island: an interactive ecosystem and evolution experience.



A 3D nephron simulation for renal anatomy and physiology.



An interactive human heart anatomy viewer.



Planned operating-room simulations, surgical anatomy environments, and additional science laboratories.



We already have an operational development workflow and working prototypes. We are seeking an artist to help elevate the visual realism, asset quality, and animation of these experiences.



Responsibilities



3D Modeling and Environment Design



Create realistic 3D models, environments, props, and scientific visualizations.



Develop detailed mountains, rocks, snow, ice, terrain, and expedition equipment.



Create realistic operating-room environments, hospital equipment, surgical instruments, and medical props.



Build or adapt anatomical models using provided scientific references.



Produce realistic materials, textures, lighting setups, and environmental details.



Rigging and Animation



Rig and animate characters, wildlife, and interactive objects.



Develop natural movement and realistic animation sequences.



Prepare assets for use in interactive simulations.



Collaborate with our developer on animation and model integration.



Technical Asset Preparation



Work primarily in Blender or comparable professional 3D software.



Export models in GLB/glTF and other suitable formats.



Optimize polygon counts, texture sizes, UV maps, and materials for browser performance.



Create PBR textures and organized model hierarchies.



Prepare clean, editable source files and document asset specifications.



Modify licensed third-party assets when their terms permit it.



Scientific and Educational Quality



Follow supplied anatomical, scientific, and technical references.



Identify when an anatomical or scientific detail requires expert verification.



Avoid inventing anatomical structures or presenting visually attractive but inaccurate models as scientifically validated.



Work collaboratively with developers and subject-matter reviewers.



Required Qualifications



Strong portfolio of professional 3D modeling work.



Proficiency in Blender.



Experience with realistic texturing, UV mapping, lighting, and PBR materials.



Experience optimizing 3D models for real-time applications.



Ability to export and troubleshoot GLB/glTF assets.



Strong communication and ability to follow visual references.



Willingness to work on existing projects rather than requiring a complete redesign.



Highly Preferred Qualifications



Experience with medical or anatomical visualization.



Experience with realistic terrain and environment creation.



Character rigging and animation.



Experience with Three.js or WebGL asset workflows.



Experience with procedural modeling, photogrammetry, sculpting, or ZBrush.



Experience with interactive simulations, game development, or educational applications.



Experience in every category is not required. Please clearly identify your strongest specialties.



What Success Looks Like



We want 3D experiences that feel professional, realistic, and immersive without sacrificing educational accuracy or website performance.



For medical anatomy, visual accuracy must be evaluated against credible references and approved by appropriate subject-matter reviewers before educational publication.



We value originality, attention to detail, technical discipline, and a collaborative approach.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your portfolio, ArtStation, Sketchfab, or comparable work samples.



Examples of realistic environments, anatomical models, rigged characters, or interactive assets.



Your experience preparing models for browser-based applications.



Your hourly rate and availability.



Your preferred 3D software and export formats.



Whether you have previously worked on scientific, medical, or educational visualizations.



Application question: How would you create a realistic, browser-optimized human heart or snowy mountain environment for an interactive science education platform, and what would you do to ensure the final model is accurate and performs well?



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a small, paid practical assignment.



We are excited to collaborate with artists who enjoy combining technical skill, creativity, and education.

### Long-Term Growth & Career Opportunities



Kiku Learning is an early-stage educational technology company with ambitious plans for growth. Our vision extends beyond creating a traditional learning website. We are developing a comprehensive, interactive science and healthcare education platform designed to serve students across multiple disciplines and potentially around the world.



Although this position will begin as part-time, flexible, and project-based, **we are looking for individuals who may be interested in growing with the company long-term.**



As Kiku Learning develops, expands its curriculum, launches additional interactive laboratories, and grows its subscriber base, there may be opportunities for:



- Transitioning into a full-time position with a more structured schedule and established compensation.

- Increased hourly compensation based on responsibilities, performance, company growth, and available funding.

- Advancement into senior, lead, or management roles as the technical and creative teams expand.

- Taking ownership of larger projects, new learning experiences, and future platform developments.

- Becoming a long-term member of Kiku Learning's core development team.



We value creativity, initiative, technical excellence, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to making science education more accessible and engaging.



Our goal is to build a team where talented individuals have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, develop professionally, and grow alongside the company.



**Please note:** Future full-time employment, promotions, and compensation increases are potential opportunities rather than guaranteed commitments. They will depend on business performance, funding, individual contributions, and organizational needs.

What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has a genuine interest in whisky and understands the whisky industry



Is familiar with different whisky categories, including Scotch, bourbon, Irish whiskey, Japanese whisky, and world whisky



Can write 3 news articles per day from Monday to Friday



Can research and complete each article within approximately 30 minutes



Has a distinctive, engaging, and natural writing style



Produces factually accurate articles and conducts proper research



Can independently identify interesting whisky news from reliable industry sources



Does not rely solely on ChatGPT or other AI tools to generate content



Is fluent in English



Has basic knowledge of SEO, including headings, keywords, and readability



Can upload articles independently and correctly into our admin system



Meets deadlines consistently



Understands the difference between informative journalism and promotional content



The articles must be suitable for an international audience of whisky enthusiasts, from beginners to experienced collectors, and ready for professional publication.



Important – Please Read Before Applying



Unfortunately, we haven't always had the best experiences with freelance writers in the past.



Some applicants claimed to have experience with whisky or a strong understanding of the industry, but once the collaboration started, it became clear that their actual knowledge was quite limited.



We want to avoid this situation moving forward.



We are not necessarily looking for a certified whisky expert, but we do expect genuine interest, basic industry knowledge, and a willingness to stay informed about developments in the whisky world.



If you are seriously interested in this position, please explain why YOU believe you are the right candidate for this role.



What makes you different from other applicants? Why should we trust you to deliver accurate, interesting, and well-researched whisky news consistently?



We appreciate honest answers much more than exaggerated claims about experience.



Our Policy on AI-Generated Content



We are not looking for copy-paste work or fully AI-generated articles.



AI tools may be used to support research, translation, or article structuring, but the finished articles must clearly reflect a human writing style.



All information must be factually accurate, properly researched, and based on reliable sources.



We value writers who can turn whisky industry announcements and press releases into engaging, original news articles rather than simply rewriting promotional material.



If your approach is to copy a press release into ChatGPT and publish the result without proper research, this position is not for you.



What You Can Expect



A consistent monthly collaboration



Growth opportunities based on performance



The opportunity to become part of our growing editorial team



The chance to develop your knowledge of the international whisky industry



Potential expansion into whisky reviews, distillery features, interviews, buying guides, and special reports



A long-term working relationship if the collaboration is successful



Application



Interested?



Please send us:



2 to 3 examples of previously written articles, preferably in English



A short explanation of your writing experience and knowledge of whisky



Any SEO experience you may have



Your availability



Your connection to or interest in the whisky industry



Any experience writing about spirits, drinks, lifestyle, or related industries



A personal explanation of why you believe you are the right person for this position



We are particularly interested in hearing about your genuine connection to whisky. Whether you enjoy exploring different distilleries, following new releases, collecting bottles, or simply keeping up with whisky industry news, we want to know what makes this subject interesting to you.



One Final Question



To show us that you have carefully read this entire job description, please tell us what your favorite type of whisky glass is and why you prefer it.





Applications that do not answer this question may not be considered.



We look forward to building a long-term collaboration with someone who genuinely enjoys the world of whisky, takes their work seriously, understands the importance of accurate reporting, and values high-quality content.



We are looking for reliability, genuine interest, and quality — not just someone who can produce articles quickly.

title: Growth & Operations Manager — Australian Construction SaaS (Sales, GoHighLevel, Marketing)
description:
Buildops Systems Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced remote contractor to help launch and grow two software brands serving the Australian building industry: a construction CRM and a construction project-management tool. You will work directly with the owner and take ownership of marketing, sales and customer delivery, then help build and manage a team as the brands grow. This is a senior, hands-on role — not an entry-level VA position.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Cold call prospects, run software demos, follow up on enquiries and close sales using approved offers.

- Build and manage GoHighLevel campaigns, pipelines, forms and automations.

- Create social content and videos, landing pages and paid ad campaigns; report results and spend.

- Configure customer CRM accounts, onboard and train customers, and provide first-line support.

- Assess both brands and propose launch priorities, targets and a marketing budget for approval.

- Recruit and assess future team members for approval, then manage their daily delivery and quality.

- Report weekly against agreed targets, keep accurate records and take responsibility for solving problems.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING (please give specific examples of your own results)

- Cold calling and outbound sales to business owners/decision-makers, in fluent, confident spoken English.

- Running software demos and converting prospects to paying customers.

- Paid advertising with measurable results (Meta/Google) — budgets, leads, conversions you can point to.

- Launching or growing a software subscription (SaaS) business.

- GoHighLevel experience — building campaigns, pipelines, automations and dashboards.

- Sales management and client account management / onboarding.

- Exceptional spoken and written English, strong problem-solving, and the ability to own marketing, sales and customer delivery end-to-end with minimal supervision.

- Leadership / managing remote people is a plus. Construction or trades industry experience is a bonus, not required. Product training does not replace the essential skills for this role.



ENGAGEMENT

- Starts at ~20 hours per week, long-term, with a performance and rate review at three months (no guaranteed increase).

- Flexible delivery around agreed meetings and Australian (Perth / AWST) customer appointments.

- Weekly invoicing; payment weekly. Other clients are acceptable outside agreed commitments.

- Time tracking with Trackabi (task descriptions + activity screenshots) is required.

- You must have your own computer, reliable internet with a backup, a power-outage contingency, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset and webcam.

- One-off signup bonuses apply for eligible new customers you personally sign up (full rules provided to shortlisted applicants).



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please include:

1. A short introduction and your earliest start date and weekly availability (in Perth/AWST time).

2. Your answers to these questions, with specific examples and measurable results:

   - Describe a software subscription (SaaS) business you helped launch or grow — the starting point, what YOU did, and the paying customers or revenue that resulted.

   - Give one cold-calling / sales example where you personally progressed a prospect to payment. What did you say and do?

   - Describe one paid ad campaign you ran — platform, budget, leads, and paying customers — and how you measured attribution.

   - Describe a GoHighLevel workflow you built (triggers, follow-up, stop rules).

3. Two work samples (marketing/video content and sales/operational delivery) using links that can be viewed without requesting access.



Shortlisted applicants complete a short recorded screening interview; the strongest candidates progress to a live second-round interview with the owner. Please redact any confidential client information.
